acceptance_rules.budget: Each numeric budget caps elapsed timed GPU reservation per arm per execution; one reserved GPU makes gpu_s equal process-wall seconds. Fixed full workload only. An unfinished execution at cap has sample-pass=0 and censored time; no extrapolated speedup, no treating cap as measured completion time. Warmups and repeated executions have separately accounted cost. No restart accumulation, changed paths or scale to fill budget. Retain stage timeouts from intake; incomplete required pairs/seeds give inconclusive result.
acceptance_rules.equivalence: For each seed use paired sample-pass difference method minus baseline at fixed full workload. Across 64 independent RNG seeds use exact two-sided 95% binomial median order-statistic bounds, Bonferroni across equivalence metrics (one metric). Both bounds must lie inclusively inside [0,0]. Claim restricted to median acceptance difference plus all-seed acceptance, not pricing-distribution equivalence.
acceptance_rules.performance: Per seed and budget collect 15 completed baseline/method timing pairs after two full warmup executions per arm. Randomize arm order independently per pair using sealed scheduler seed, process seeds and budgets in seeded randomized order, serialize GPU use. Use paired ratios baseline_wall/method_wall, exact one-sided 95% binomial order-statistic lower bound on median; require lower bound > 1.05 for every seed and budget to claim benefit throughout domain. No pooling repeated timings into independent seed samples.
acceptance_rules.scientific: Require both arms to pass published anchors and every representative seed, regardless of equivalence interval. Equal failures never count as success. Verify printed GPU/options/path counts. No significance test substitutes for equivalence.
acceptance_rules.scope_changes: Changing inputs, seeds, target, tolerances, timing scope or budgets requires new sealed run.

evaluation_inputs.availability: Generated inputs available by specification; published hashes unavailable. Upstream has no seed CLI. Seed support and logical stream preservation are future evaluator requirements, unverified; if unavailable, protocol cannot execute and no equivalence or speedup claim is permitted.
evaluation_inputs.environment_pins: Same physical GPU, CUDA toolkit 12.8, driver and libc across all arms. Record exact GPU model, SM count, grid dimensions, toolkit, driver patch and libc before evaluation; actual values unavailable in intake. Pin recorded values throughout, reject geometry or version drift.
evaluation_inputs.rng_pairing: Prospective evaluator seed support required: seed each logical upstream cuRAND stream with global seed + blockIdx.x + gridDim.x * device_id, sequence threadIdx.x, offset 0. Global seeds 1001 through 1064. Preserve logical stream identity and original grid across scheduling partitions. Same options and logical random variates per paired seed in both arms. Host seed remains 123.

specification.generation: Pinned sample host rand() generation; same libc and generated option bytes in both arms. No scale search or PATH_N change.

evidence_and_assumptions.bound: 1 / ((1-p) + p/k), supplied bounds.json ceilings; p=0.8200983147482103, k=8 for both feasible methods. One GPU remains exposed; k models intra-device actionable acceleration, not eight physical GPUs.
evidence_and_assumptions.gates: No gate scripts named in task or intake; none run.
evidence_and_assumptions.limits: Profile contains one aggregate process-wall observation, no repetitions, output values, GPU model, scale confirmation or method runs. Representative-scale applicability and successful completion within budgets are prospective assumptions. No measured gains, correctness variability or outcome curves available.
evidence_and_assumptions.overhead_model: Assume T_method/T_baseline = (1-p)+p/q+h. h includes incremental worker/kernel launch, transfer and merge overhead as fractions of profiled process-wall baseline. Existing setup/transfer costs already inside observed profile; do not remove fixed wall overhead. q and h are unmeasured design assumptions.

infeasible_methods.reason: Supplied actionable p=0, k=4; Amdahl ceiling 1 < 1.05. No actionable batch fraction established.
Supplied actionable p=0, k=2; ceiling 1 < 1.05. No actionable overlap fraction established.

metric_definition.sample-pass: 1 only if Average reserve strictly exceeds 1.0, stdout says Test passed and process exits successfully; otherwise 0. At six-decimal boundary use verdict/unrounded reserve. This is published acceptance equivalence only, not equality of prices or distributions. L1 recorded descriptively; no numeric L1 margin published, none invented.

power_analysis.alternative: At each budget paired published acceptance indicators agree with probability at least 0.90 independently across RNG seeds; both arms additionally must pass every evaluation seed. This powers equivalence of acceptance, not guarantee of all-seed acceptance.
power_analysis.calculation: Sufficient event: at least n-k+1 of n paired differences equal zero, forcing both CI endpoints zero regardless of remaining differences. Binomial(n=64,p=0.90) upper tail gives stated power. Zero absolute margin comes from exact published binary acceptance requirement, not method outputs. No measured power or baseline variability claimed.
power_analysis.status: Prospective design assumption; no seed variability measurements available.
power_analysis.timing: 15 pairs provide finite exact one-sided 95% median bounds. Timing power unknown without paired timing variability; no power guarantee for speedup.

timing_scope.description: Time full process from launch until successful exit, including CUDA discovery, input generation, allocation, RNG setup, option preprocessing, launch overhead, H2D transfers, GPU pricing, D2H transfers, completion synchronization, result merge/finalization, Black-Scholes validation, reporting and teardown. Include method workers and merge inside timer. Compilation excluded. This matches profile process-wall scope; upstream streamed Total time is secondary only.
